title: prepare to migrate boil.py to golang
description: I want basic unit and integration tests for the 'boil' command so that we can write boil.py to boil.go and the tests will still be valid. The best starting point would be tests/test_example_repos.py since it is a pretty good integration test. I also want to make sure we have coverage for 'boil --check' and 'boil --abort' and 'boil --finish', but i dont think those tests exist. To be clear: dont write any golang yet. Just add more tests that cover the 'boil' executable in a python-agnostic way (so we can seamlessly switch to golang later for the implementation)

title: move boil.py and pipeline to a new src/ directory
description:
Creating a src/ folder distinct from the tests/ folder will allow us
to play with file permissions such that src editors can be blocked from editing tests, and vice-versa

it will also clean up the root of the repo.

please move boil.py and all it's dependencies into src/

the tests/ dir is allowed to import from src/
src/ is not allowed to import from test
neither should import from the root of the repo.
